name: BabyAI User
background: You are acting in a grid-based world and must follow instructions to navigate, interact with objects (keys, balls, boxes), and operate doors. Each task instance is procedurally generated by a level and a seed.

entities.name: GridObject
entities.description: Any object in the grid world, including keys, balls, boxes, and doors.

attrs.type: Object type (key, ball, box, door, etc.).
attrs.position: Approximate relative position or location in the grid.
attrs.state: For doors: open/closed/locked; for carried items: in-inventory vs on-floor.

opts.name: turn
opts.description: Turn left or right to change facing direction.

opts.name: move_forward
opts.description: Move forward one step if not blocked.

opts.name: pickup_drop
opts.description: Pick up an object or drop the currently carried item.

opts.name: toggle
opts.description: Toggle the object in front (open/close door, unlock if holding matching key).

opts.name: go_through
opts.description: Go through an open door (or toggle-and-go-through if supported).
